question: ‘Farewell My Friend’ was an album by which musician?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Pandit Ravi Shankar__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Farewell, My Friend** was an album composed by **Pandit Ravi Shankar**.
 
• This album was **released in 1992**.
 
• During the 1950s, Ravi Shankar collaborated with **Satyajit Ray** on a trilogy about a Bengali boy's life.
